name: TaxClassification
description: Segregates items into different tax classifications, a key parameter used to determine the appropriate tax on transactions involving items, sourced from tax governing authorities or external providers.

search.note: Read TaxClassifications: all (GET /v3/company/<realmID>/taxclassification), by parent ID (.../taxclassification/<parentid>/children), or by level (.../taxclassification?level=<level>). No SQL-style query operation is documented; only these read endpoints.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object (present in sample JSON, e.g. 'EUC-01010101-V1-00100000'). Read only, system defined.

fields.name: ParentRef
fields.description: Reference Type for parent tax classification.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the referenced parent tax classification.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced parent tax classification.

fields.name: ApplicableTo
fields.description: List of item types the tax classification is applicable to. Includes Inventory, NonInventory, Bundle and Service.

fields.name: Level
fields.description: Tax classification level (numeric value 1 or 2; 1 specifies a parent tax classification). Read only.
